integrity: Analytical covariance, Fourier and finite-dependence proofs; a standalone deterministic numerical checker is provided as a diagnostic, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The sharp optimization covers only one-dimensional periodic-inhomogeneous Poisson point processes, second factorial window-count observable, and integer-length physical-time averages.
The upper variance bound is approached by regular profiles but not attained in the strictly positive continuous class.
No numerical or analytical claim is made for interaction between coordinates, general target count laws, or relative event-count efficiency.
Independent mathematical audit and exhaustive priority verification are outstanding.
title: Sharp spectral variance cost of periodic Poisson count sampling
